summary: SPK RC 45 sua loi go 1 ky tu la mat focus o moi o nhap lieu trong toan he thong (Public URL, Runtime config, moi thanh vien...).
changes: Sua loi UI goc re: render() ve lai toan bo innerHTML nen moi lan go phim goi render/scheduleRender se pha huy va tao lai input dang go, buoc phai click lai vao o moi go tiep duoc ky tu ke tiep.

Them co che chung: render() tu dong ghi nho o dang focus + vi tri con tro truoc khi ve lai, va phuc hoi lai sau khi ve xong — ap dung cho MOI input/textarea/select co id trong toan he thong, khong can vi tri tung o rieng.
Cac o Runtime config (Public URL, DSM host, DSM mount root...) va o them thanh vien DSM truoc day khong co id nen khong the phuc hoi focus — da them id on dinh cho tung o.
Go bo 2 co che vi phuc hoi focus rieng le (_focusComment, _focusWorkspaceSearch) vi co che chung moi da bao quat, giam trung lap logic.
